flashcards.back: A count out of one hundred: 25% is 25 out of 100, whatever the whole in the question is.
A square split into one hundred equal cells for picturing a percent: twenty-five shaded cells out of one hundred is 25%.
One of four equal parts of a whole: 25 out of 100 simplifies to one quarter, so 25% of a quantity is a quarter of it.
The full amount the percent is taken of: in 25% of 60 the whole is 60, so the answer is a share of 60.

The 25 is read as a raw count instead of 25 out of 100. Percent means per hundred, and the whole here is 60: 25% of 60 is a quarter of 60, which is 15. In the animation scene s2 the claim is tested against the hundred-grid and fails: the 25 belongs to the hundred, never to the 60.

flashcards.front: 25% as a fraction in its simplest form is...

items.prompt: 25% as a fraction in its simplest form is...
Write 25% as a fraction in its simplest form and explain the step.
items.answer: 25% = 25/100 = 1/4: divide the top and the bottom by 25.
